verdict.rationale: The only natural-language control in the evidence is narrow: the AI Form Builder lets users describe a form and generates it, and the AI interview guide generates questions. Nothing shows operating Lever in general through natural-language commands, such as moving, tagging or searching candidates or running reports. Other AI features (Talent Fit matching, transcripts and summaries) are automation, not command interfaces. Missing for 10: a general natural-language command or assistant interface across core ATS workflows, documentation of conversational operation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
